## Details
### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-001** — Nav App Scheduled at 100 Hz

- **Description:** The nav app shall execute on the static schedule at 100 Hz throughout the mission.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-012 fixes nav output cadence at 100 Hz; the app runs at this rate.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-012
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-002** — IMU Message Subscription

- **Description:** The nav app shall subscribe to IMU messages on the software bus.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-002 requires live nav; IMU input enters the app via the bus.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-002
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-003** — Barometer Message Subscription

- **Description:** The nav app shall subscribe to barometric altimeter messages on the software bus.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-002 requires live nav; baro input enters the app via the bus.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-002
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

- **Description:** The nav app shall publish a navigation state message on the software bus at 100 Hz.

- **Children:** None

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-006** — Sixteen-State Composition Published

- **Description:** The nav app shall publish a navigation state containing position, velocity, attitude quaternion, and accelerometer and gyroscope biases.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-013 defines the 16-state composition; the app publishes it.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-013
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-007** — Nav State Timestamp

- **Description:** The nav app shall include a monotonic microsecond timestamp on every published navigation state message.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-012 output cadence and SYS-026 monotonic time base require per-message timestamps.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-012
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-008** — Validity Flag Published

- **Description:** The nav app shall publish a navigation validity flag on the software bus alongside each navigation state message.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-015 requires the validity flag to be observable to consumers.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-015
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-009** — Validity False on Missing Inputs

- **Description:** The nav app shall set the published validity flag false when required nav inputs are unavailable.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-059 mandates validity reflects degraded input state at the app boundary.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-059
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-010** — Continue Publishing on Missing Inputs

- **Description:** The nav app shall continue publishing navigation state at 100 Hz when one or more sensor inputs are unavailable.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-034 requires nav propagation to continue when sensor inputs drop.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-034
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-011** — Position Bound to Latest GPS Fix

- **Description:** The nav app shall keep its published position estimate within a configured horizontal distance of the latest GPS fix.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-014 mandates a black-box GPS divergence bound at the app boundary.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-014
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-012** — POSIX Build Functional Equivalence

- **Description:** The nav app shall produce identical published navigation state on POSIX and Pico2 builds for identical inputs.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-043 requires the POSIX build to be functionally equivalent to the Pico2 build.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-013** — Deterministic Navigation Output

- **Description:** The nav app shall produce deterministic navigation state output given identical sensor input sequences.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-044 requires deterministic outputs for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-014** — Boost-Phase Sensor Update Skipping

- **Description:** The nav app shall skip baro and GPS measurement updates during the boost phase.
- **Rationale:** PM directive 2026-05-03: GPS multipath and baro shock during boost (high-G, transient pressure) make those measurements unreliable; IMU-only dead-reckoning is the safer fusion strategy during the ~500 ms boost interval.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-013
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NAV-APP-015** — Post-Boost Settling Window for Sensor Re-Enablement

- **Description:** The nav app shall delay baro and GPS update re-enablement by one second after boost-phase exit.
- **Rationale:** PM directive 2026-05-03: 1-second settling window allows IMU bias estimates to converge after the boost-phase shock before fusion of GPS and baro resumes; configurable via NAV_APP_INIT_T for per-build tuning.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-NAV-APP-014
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
